body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target moves up to 2 units into a space with cover, or 1 unit if no cover is available, then reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Ignore difficult terrain during the movement.
The target also gains +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Lock - Targeting
rider.html: Your current Lock persists through one break in sight until the end of your next turn; if it is restored sooner, you may transfer it to a different visible creature without a burn.
